note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs. Sponsor slots are labeled with a bold 'TOGETHER WITH OUR SPONSOR' paragraph above the advertisementOpportunity node (padding 12 top/bottom, 20 sides). Ads: place 1 top (after intro) + 2 bottom (around the sign-off), never stacked.
ad_placement_lesson: To embed an ad, use the already-ACCEPTED opportunity UUID from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted), NOT the integer offer id from list_ad_offers. Embedding an integer offer id tries to claim a NEW opportunity and the API rejects it with 'can not accept any more opportunities' once the cycle's offers are already accepted. Each daily run typically has 3 fresh accepted opportunities (created that morning) with a send_by ~5 days out — those are the current inventory.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Story sections use h2 headings (Models & Research, Industry & Business). Sign-off + Share button at the end. Sponsor slots use advertisementOpportunity nodes labeled 'A word from our sponsor' only when offers/agreements exist.
